revisions.goal: Prepare the eve 0.5.0 release using the existing repository release process and record the release in EVE.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: npm/eve package metadata is bumped to 0.5.0; CHANGELOG.md contains a dated 0.5.0 section summarizing changes since 0.4.0; relevant release verification passes; implementation changes are committed; an EVE release snapshot is completed and the generated .eve record is committed separately.

milestones.title: Review prior release flow
milestones.goal: Use prior EVE release snapshots and scripts/prepare-release.sh to follow the established release procedure.

milestones.title: Prepare release metadata
milestones.goal: Add the 0.5.0 changelog notes and run scripts/prepare-release.sh 0.5.0 to update release files.

milestones.title: Verify release
milestones.goal: Run focused package checks and repository tests appropriate for a metadata release.

milestones.title: Record release history
milestones.goal: Commit implementation files, create the EVE release snapshot, then commit the generated .eve files.
